desc: Derive the precise BFS-layer characterization: edges occur only within equal/consecutive layers, and each vertex in a non-root layer needs a predecessor-layer neighbor.
Develop an efficient exact DP for layer compositions, parity balance, and all edge coefficients under N ≤ 30.
Determine a practical polynomial reconstruction method modulo an arbitrary large prime P and complexity bounds.
Fix DP topological transition processing order and verify mandatory predecessor-neighbor factors and label/EGF factorial factors prevent overcounting.
Produce and validate a complete Python implementation with modular arithmetic, coefficient extraction, output formatting, and all samples.
